precedence: Part7 and its normative references prevail for deterministic AFDX. Separate companion editions require a documented compatibility review. General RFC behavior must not silently override the ARINC profile.

scope.switch_role: Reference network model for end-system timing and failure tests; no switch product certification claim

standard_limits_policy: All capacities in competition_profile.json are project implementation bounds, not universal ARINC limits. Four primary ports retain 8192-byte payloads; twelve added Sub-VL ports default to configurable 2048-byte payload capacity. Sampling is unfragmented within LMAX.
format_revision_caution: A4 wire marker and665 format0x8004 are not proof of615A-4 or665-5 conformance.
rtc_policy: Bounded single-server NTPv4 on-wire response profile; not full RFC5905 peer selection/clock-discipline suite. RFC5905 has subsequent updates; applicability review remains OPEN.
catalog_scope_note: Edition identifiers express the selected project baseline, not a latest-edition or full-compliance claim. Public catalog metadata is not normative clause evidence.
requirements_inventory_kind: 33 work-package families, NOT an exhaustive normative clause inventory

implementation_progress_note: Native port config bank and TX/RX support are integrated: four VLs, four Sub-VLs per VL, 16 port/SAP bindings, frame-based round-robin, shared VL BAG/SN. Full selected-standard coverage remains OPEN.
